cards.label: Cost
cards.text: One ticket covers the full weekend: all three sessions, Friday’s dessert bar, and Saturday’s refreshments. *Non-refundable.*

cards.label: Who
cards.title: Women 16+
cards.text: Join us on your own, or bring your mom, your daughter, your small group, or a friend who hasn’t been to church in a while.
